beat: Drink choices, Raj and Dhika in kitchen, dinner social dynamic

lines.original: As they moved inside... Sharmi grabbed wine and 4 glasses... and started filling...
lines.local: Andar aate hi Sharmi wine aur chaar glasses le aayi aur bharne lagi.

lines.original: While she filled and handed one to John.... Dhika interrupted saying not for her.... only then she remembered Dhika doesn't drink.... when she started pouring one more for Raj..... he too declined....
lines.local: John ko glass dete waqt Dhika ne apne liye mana kar diya; tab Sharmi ko yaad aaya Dhika drink nahi karti. Raj ko dene lagi toh usne bhi mana kar diya.

lines.original: Raj: I don't want dear... someone has to accompany the guest...
lines.local: Raj: Nahi dear, kisi ko toh guest ka saath dena chahiye.

lines.original: Dhika: aww.... you don't have to, you can join them.....
lines.local: Dhika: Aww, zaroori nahi; tum bhi inke saath enjoy karo.

lines.original: John and Sharmi took their glasses and headed towards the sofa.... while Raj said he would go and make tea for them....
lines.local: John aur Sharmi wine ke glasses lekar sofa ki taraf chale gaye. Raj ne kaha woh chai bana laayega.

lines.original: Dhika: oh, wait Raj....let me come and make.. she smiled..
lines.local: Dhika: Ruko Raj, main chalti hoon, chai bana deti hoon. Woh muskuraayi.

lines.original: Sharmi was enjoying her time with John and was not at all interested in making tea for Raj or Dhika for that matter.
lines.local: Sharmi John ke saath waqt bitaane mein mashgool thi; Raj ya Dhika ke liye chai banaane ka mann nahi tha.

lines.original: Raj and Dhika went into the kitchen and without letting Dhika, Raj started making tea for her..... Dhika got so impressed at Raj, because John knows nothing in cooking but making hot water.....
lines.local: Raj aur Dhika kitchen gaye. Dhika ko banaane nahi diya; Raj khud uske liye chai banaane laga. Dhika impressed thi—John ko hot water banaane ke alawa cooking kuch nahi aati.

lines.original: Raj is a funny person.... always cracking jokes. All the while making the tea, Raj kept Dhika giggling and laughing........ and with each passing minute, she thought highly of him and.... she felt closer to him....
lines.local: Raj mazaakia aadmi hai, hamesha jokes karta hai. Chai banaate waqt Dhika ko baar-baar hansata raha. Har minute Dhika ki nazar mein uski izzat badhi aur woh uske saath zyada comfortable/close feel karne lagi.

lines.original: John too heard a lot of giggles coming from the kitchen..... but he was busy listening to all the flirting sharmi was throwing at him.....
lines.local: John ko bhi kitchen se bahut giggles sunaayi de rahe the, lekin woh Sharmi ke flirt sunne mein busy tha.

lines.original: When Raj and Dhika returned with their tea..... instead of taking the single sofa like before.... Dhika sat next to Raj but not as close as Sharmi was next to John...
lines.local: Raj aur Dhika chai lekar laute. Is baar Dhika pehle waale single sofa ke bajaay Raj ke paas baithi, magar John ke paas Sharmi jitna kareeb nahi.

lines.original: Grinning to himself, John raise his eyebrows looking at Dhika,... for which she just smiled a little.....
lines.local: John ne khud muskuraakar bhaunhein uthaakar Dhika ko dekha; usne bas halki smile se jawaab diya.

lines.original: They all chatted a while and later, moved to the dining room... enjoyed a nice dinner made by Sharmi while the coversations revolved around the house....and then a bit about work... and then into movies....
lines.local: Sab kuch der baat karte rahe; baad mein dining room mein Sharmi ka banaya dinner khaaya. Baat ghar se kaam aur phir movies ki taraf badhti gayi.
